title: Verify Administrator can delete a work order line
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Administrator role. (this role has Work Order Lines: Delete).
The work order contains at least one line that is NOT in Complete status (a line can be deleted in any status except Complete).
steps:
1. Open the work order and locate a line that is not in Complete status.
2. Open the line's action menu and click Delete.
3. Confirm the deletion in the confirmation dialog.
expected: The line is deleted and disappears from the work order. Work order totals recalculate without the deleted line.
